claim: Brot posted a 'BAKED REPORT': its team talked to IslandDAO, hit some issues, and said the product is on devnet.
IslandDAO replied to Brot's devnet report with 'this is the way'.
Official site states Brot is in a test phase on Solana devnet with test SOL, the program is not audited, mainnet is 'coming soon', and opening a campaign will cost US$500 in SOL.
Chainless was one of three startups highlighted by organizers at the IslandDAO v5 Demo Day (29 Oct, Open Lounge Jurere In).

Chainless shipped seven iOS releases between 2 Oct and about 3 Nov 2026 (1.27.0 to 1.27.5): new liquidity pools on Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum, in-flow bridge suggestions, Bitcoin and Pix withdrawal improvements.
An IslandDAO organizer named @chainlesscripto as one of the promising analytics-driven projects 'discovered here at @islanddao Brazil'.

IslandDAO cofounder's recap: Cloak came to v3 in Mykonos a year ago, won 3rd place at the Colosseum Cypherpunk hackathon and joined Cohort 4, went live on mainnet, has private payments and payroll live.
IslandDAO story post: 'A year ago, @cloak_ag came to @islanddao and started shipping. Today, they're live on mainnet and back on the island' in Brazil alongside Superteam Brazil (video).
Official site banner: 'Private USDC, USDT & SOL payments are now open to everyone'; company page names Cloak Privacy Corp. and lists an SDK, docs and a GitHub org.
IslandDAO organizer paid the group food order through conta.vc 'in seconds', in USDC on Solana.
Conta.vc was listed among the projects presented at IslandDAO v5 in Florianopolis (Pix payments in reais on blockchain rails, digital dollar to real conversion).
@contavcbr went from 469 to 1,296 monthly active wallets in October 2026, per IslandDAO organizer's week-3 recap.
Envio published an open-source HyperIndex indexer for the Solana program behind IslandDAO event check-ins plus a live IslandDAO x Envio dashboard (leaderboard, analytics, islander profiles).
Developer Update October 2026: HyperIndex v3.14.0 (Rust terminal UI, add a chain to a running indexer, type-checked handlers) and Envio Indexer passed all 44 reliability checks in its open benchmark.
An IslandDAO organizer named @envio_indexer among promising projects 'discovered here at @islanddao Brazil'.

project: Founder Cafe on Solana / Founder Haus
claim: A local outlet reported Founder Haus among the organizers listed on the IslandDAO v5 Demo Day page.
FUD posted that it is live on the Solana Mobile dApp Store, with prediction markets tradable on the Seeker.
Official site shows LONG/SHORT crypto markets on Solana, 15-minute markets, a live points program, and a live $FUD token (mint Gcku9A4XsNEv42WjHFrpyNJt5u5nwZDDh1BFyrqGpump) linked to Dexscreener.
Published how it automated most of its sales team's operational work with an internal AI system (Petros).
Mutav presented its Solana-based rental-guarantee reserve at the IslandDAO v5 Demo Day, Open Lounge Jurere In, Florianopolis.
IslandDAO-affiliated account thanked Mutav 'for participating in @islanddao v5' and called it the first decentralized rental guarantee protocol on Solana.
Mutav published its blog with four guides on Brazilian rental guarantees (Lei 8.245/91), all dated 06 Nov 2026.
Cloak's privacy technology was reported to power the launch of private $BRS transactions, in collaboration with Nora Finance.
IslandDAO published an interview with Nora's builder: 'building @norafinancexyz, a BRL stablecoin ecosystem. Making the Brazilian real programmable onchain.'
Press named Nora Finance among five startups that took part in IslandDAO v5 in Florianopolis (BRS, 1:1 BRL stablecoin with Pix mint and redeem).
IslandDAO showed the Otta wallet built by its CTO ('Our CTO has been cooking! Check out @OttaTech wallet') with four app screenshots.
Official site shows only 'Otta. Coming soon.'
Pollar published @pollar/core and @pollar/react v0.12.0 (current 'latest' tag) to npm.
Pollar shipped five prerelease builds (0.12.1-rc.9 to rc.14) between 31 Oct and 7 Nov 2026, i.e. active release cadence during v5.
Site reports 257 developers, 629 apps created, 36 apps in production, 4,912 wallets and 51,371 npm downloads in the last 12 months, 'as of Nov 7, 2026'.
IslandDAO: 'They came to IslandDAO v4 as attendees and came back for v5 as sponsors. @ProofOfExploit took 1st at the v4 hackathon and now audits code for Solana projects.'
IslandDAO builder spotlight: a Superteam Argentina builder 'is shipping @usereflexmarket on Solana, an incentive layer for prediction markets' (video).
Last public push to the Reflex GitHub repo, the same day IslandDAO's spotlight post went out.
Official site flags a 'Launchpad NEW': launch a coin that gets its own Ride vault, bonding at $8,000 with $2,000 to the vault and the rest locked as Meteora liquidity.
Official docs describe the product (post a small bond, trade a fund's capital, keep a share of the profit) and an agent API ('Ride for agents', auth and signing, API reference).
Startupi names Rivool (wealth platform: global dollar account, international investments, digital assets, self-custody) among the projects highlighted at the IslandDAO v5 Demo Day and IslandHack.
Nightly snapshot commits continued through v5 (Snapshot 2026-11-06, Snapshot 2026-11-07); site last rebuild 2026-11-07 20:58 UTC with a free JSON API and MCP server.
Active development during v5: GitHub solanabr/superteam-academy received fix commits on 6 Nov 2026 (#1302, #1306, #1307); site shows a 'Beta' badge.
A Brot Markets campaign (Solana devnet prediction markets, $100 reward pool) ran live on Test Drive, with five builder reviews published 5 and 6 Nov 2026.
Homepage counters: 61 campaigns, 1,215 reviews, 341.6K views, 12.5K likes, 56 builders, $9,375 paid out; site labelled 'beta, obviously'.
IslandDAO v5 attendees were included in the @runnersfam allocation.
Proof of Exploit, 1st at the v4 hackathon, returned as a v5 sponsor and now audits code for Solana projects (video story).
Demo Day held at Open Lounge Jurere In, Florianopolis; between ten and twenty teams pitched; Startupi highlights Mutav, Rivool and Chainless.
IslandDAO Demo Day livestream on X Broadcasts; attendees voted for pitching projects in the IslandDAO app.
IslandDAO cofounder: 5 island builders are on the Colosseum Argentina Track board; Superteam Argentina had 9 local teams pitch at Demo Day.
IslandDAO hackathon still open after Demo Day: 5,000 USDC prize pool including a community award; deadline 10 Nov 23:59 Brasilia time.
